commonVulnerabilities.name: Missing Anti-CSRF Tokens
commonVulnerabilities.description: No Anti-CSRF tokens were found in a HTML submission form
commonVulnerabilities.solution: Implement CSRF tokens for all state-changing operations

commonVulnerabilities.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set

commonVulnerabilities.solution: Add Content-Security-Policy header to prevent XSS attacks
